intervals.label: collaboration
intervals.note: Bounds are those of the XMASS-I detector's construction start and end of stable data taking; the collaboration's own founding date is not published in the sources read.
intervals.quote: Construction of the detector started in April 2007 and was completed in September 2010.

intervals.label: completed (data taking ended)
intervals.note: The collaboration published the full-data-set analysis in 2022; no later detector run is reported in the sources read.
intervals.quote: Stable XMASS-I data taking accumulated a total live time of 1590.9 days between November 20, 2013 and February 1, 2019

name: XMASS Collaboration
notes: No roster or member count was found; the Atlas records no memberships for this collaboration.

summary.plain: The Japanese-led team that built and ran the XMASS liquid-xenon detector in the Kamioka mine, searching for dark matter and other rare events.
summary.technical: XMASS Collaboration, based at the Kamioka Observatory, Institute for Cosmic Ray Research, University of Tokyo (affiliation on the XMASS papers). No formation date or member count is published in the sources read.
